message:
Where does a $30,000 wedding budget go?

• Venue & catering: $13,500
• Photo & video: $3,600
• Flowers & décor: $3,000
• Music: $2,400
• Attire & beauty: $2,100
• Rings, cake & stationery: the rest
• An 11% buffer for the costs couples forget

With 100 guests, that's $300 per guest. Try your own total and guest count with the free calculator:

https://bridalteam.com/wedding-budget-calculator?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-11&utm_content=2026-11-07-am-budget
